newsitem.title: ESTONIA: STATE BUDGET COLLECTS 29.1 PCT OF '97 REVENUE.
newsitem.headline: STATE BUDGET COLLECTS 29.1 PCT OF '97 REVENUE.

text.p: Estonia's state budget collected 3.64 billion kroons or 29.1 percent of its planned yearly revenues by end of April, compared to 28.3 percent in the same period in 1996, the finance ministry said on Tuesday.
The ministry said in a statement that the value added tax had generated 1.75 billion kroons in revenue or 30.4 percent of the yearly plan.
The excise tax neted 616 million kroons in revenue and 272 million kroons on corporate income tax was collected.
